g.text: Re-establishing the SFP session without duplicating work or inventing an operation outcome
An SFP session is active; one or more Provider operations may be running
NEW CHANNEL AND NEW SFP SESSION
Complete snapshot · monotonic sequence · gap flag
Operations belonging to the previous Provider instance are never attributed to its replacement.
Lost state is indeterminate: StateForge never treats disconnection as failure and never retries automatically.
Availability requires current identity, compatibility, manifest, and Health validation.
